title: Separate the variables
text: Move everything with $$y$$ to one side with dy, and everything with the other variable to the other side, then integrate both sides.

title: Integrate and solve
text: Separating gives $$\frac{dy}{1-y}=dt$$, and integrating gives $$-\ln|1-y|=t+C$$ so $$1-y=A e^{\left(-t\right)}$$. With $$y(0)=0$$, $$A=1$$, so $$y=1-e^{\left(-t\right)}$$.
